key: Somatic Experience | Embodied Listening with Plants
about: Bild: Alicja Hoppel Beyond Death präsentiert Embodied Listening with Plants Embodied Listening with Plants explores how we listen to plants with and through our bodies and our experience of transitions. What emerges when we sink into our soma and become receptive to forms of expression from the plant realm? Eco-somatic practices and imaginative capacities will create an entry point to connect with plants, attune with what usually escapes our attention and will bring us into a somatic state where our bodies can trace the subtle movements and frequencies of our environment. key: Tour | Haunted by the ghosts of progress
about: Beyond Death präsentiert Haunted by the ghosts of progress: a tour of lost futures In the world today we’re no longer facing individual crises but a polycrisis of intersecting disasters. Climate breakdown. Extinction of species and ecosystems on an unprecedented level. The collapse of the international order and institutions of civil society. How did we get *here* when the arrow of history was supposed to point us to a better world of ever-increasing prosperity and progress? But maybe that’s the wrong question. What if our very notions of prosperity and progress were the good intentions that paved the road to this particular hell? Sonntag 15. November 15 Uhr Treffpunkt am Hofladen | Hermanns

about: Beyond Death präsentiert Workshop | Traurig wegen Bäumen. Gleichzeitig bedeutet Solastalgie auch Trost in der Verbundenheit mit dem, was noch besteht. Aber wie können Trauer und Trost angesichts ökologischer Verluste konkret aussehen? Anhand künstlerischer Methoden wollen wir in diesem dreistündigen Workshop Ausdrucksformen der Trauer im Kontext ökologischer Krisen erarbeiten und ihr widerständiges und tröstliches Potenzial erproben.
